Website Sign In HomeDepartmentsPolice DepartmentBoston Marathon Info Boston Marathon Info ** 2026 date is set for Monday April 20, 2026 ** The B.A.A. Boston Marathon (Boston Athletic Association) is the world's largest annual marathon and one of the world's best-known road racing events. The race is held on Patriots' Day, which falls on the third Monday of April. The marathon finishes in Copley Square, but not before passing through Natick. Natick hosts an approx. 4mi stretch of the famous marathon (from mile marker 7.5 -to- 11.7, going from west -to- east).The below information seeks to ensure a safe and fun event for runners and spectators alike.Find live race tracking for all Natick residents (active on 4/20/26) Marathon Information: 130th B.A.A.
